caption: The drawing depicts a large, slightly bulbous stoneware jug with a narrow neck and a small cork stopper at the top. The main surface of the jug is rendered in shades of gray and brown, giving it a textured, slightly mottled appearance. Prominently featured on the front of the jug is a blue decoration of a bird standing on a leafy branch, executed in cobalt blue. The bird is positioned to the left and faces to the right, with visible feather detailing. Near the base of the neck, horizontal ridges encircle the jug. The jug is centrally positioned against a plain, beige background. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is an inset showing the jug from a different angle, revealing a handle attached to its neck and shoulder. The handle is the same color and texture as the main body of the jug, and the blue decoration is partially visible from this perspective. The artist's signature, "N. Amantea," appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
